items.markdown:
Essential foods to try in Thailand include `Pad Thai, Som Tam, and Khao Soi` . These dishes offer a mix of sweet, sour, spicy, and creamy flavors that define Thai cooking.[](https://thecultureur.com/bon-appetit-15-foods-must-try-thailand/) [[1]](https://thecultureur.com/bon-appetit-15-foods-must-try-thailand/)[[2]](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/what-to-eat-and-drink-in-thailand)[[3]](https://www.mondomulia.com/2021/01/27/12-must-try-dishes-in-thailand/)[[4]](https://gailcarriger.com/2023/12/18/thai-food/)[[5]](https://thailandstartshere.com/2020/04/22/best-thai-food/)

Iconic Noodles and Rice

- **Pad Thai** : Stir-fried rice noodles with eggs, tofu, bean sprouts, and peanuts.
- **Khao Soi** : A northern Thai crispy and soft noodle dish in a rich, creamy yellow curry soup.
- **Khao Man Gai** : Tender boiled chicken served over rice cooked in chicken broth, paired with a savory bean paste sauce.[](https://thailandstartshere.com/2020/04/22/best-thai-food/) [[1]](https://thailandstartshere.com/2020/04/22/best-thai-food/)[[2]](https://www.mondomulia.com/2021/01/27/12-must-try-dishes-in-thailand/)[[3]](https://www.bestattravel.co.uk/the-edit/what-to-eat-drink-in-thailand/)[[4]](https://eatingtheglobe.com/10-of-the-best-thai-foods-you-must-try/)

Salads and Soups

- **Som Tam** : A spicy and sour green papaya salad pounded with garlic, chilies, tomatoes, and peanuts.
- **Tom Yum Goong** : A hot and sour soup packed with shrimp, lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves.[](https://www.grasshopperadventures.com/article/must-try-foods-thailand) [[1]](https://www.grasshopperadventures.com/article/must-try-foods-thailand)[[2]](https://migrationology.com/100-best-thai-dishes-to-eat-in-bangkok-ultimate-eating-guide/)

Curries and Stir-Fries

- **Massaman Curry** : A mild, rich southern curry made with coconut milk, potatoes, and tender meat.
- **Pad Kraprow** : Meat (often minced pork or chicken) stir-fried with holy basil, chilies, and garlic, usually topped with a fried egg.[](https://thecultureur.com/bon-appetit-15-foods-must-try-thailand/) 

Sweets

- **Mango Sticky Rice** : Glutinous rice cooked in sweet coconut milk, served with fresh ripe mango slices.[](https://thailandstartshere.com/2020/04/22/best-thai-food/)
